proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ F X hX h0
  have hS : MeasureTheory.Submartingale (-X) F P := hX.neg
  have hb : ∀ n, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm ((-X) n) 1 P ≤ Real.toNNReal (∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P) := by
    intro n
    have hle : ∫ ω, X n ω ∂P ≤ ∫ ω, X 0 ω ∂P := by
      have := hX.setIntegral_le (Nat.zero_le n) (MeasurableSet.univ)
      simpa using this
    have hn : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm ((-X) n) 1 P = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, X n ω ∂P) := by
      rw [Pi.neg_apply, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_neg, MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm, MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hX.integrable n) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => h0 n ω)]
      refine MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr fun ω => ?_
      rw [Real.enorm_of_nonneg (h0 n ω)]
    rw [hn]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hle
  refine ⟨fun ω => -F.limitProcess (-X) P ω, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (MeasureTheory.memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (MeasureTheory.Filtration.memLp_limitProcess_of_eLpNorm_bdd (fun n => ((hS.stronglyMeasurable n).mono (F.le n)).aestronglyMeasurable) hb)).neg
  · filter_upwards [hS.ae_tendsto_limitProcess hb] with ω hω
    have := hω.neg
    simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Supermartingale X F P → (∀ n ω, 0 ≤ X n ω) → ∃ g : Ω → ℝ, MeasureTheory.Integrable g P ∧ ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => X n ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (g ω))
